src: colored non-line sprite s matched to a one-cell-thick control bar sharing s's row span or column span
path: straight cardinal path from s toward the matching bar: vertical for a horizontal bar with the same columns, horizontal for a vertical bar with the same rows; stop after the repeated sprite covers the bar line
trajectory: copy s every full sprite height/width along the path, clipping at grid edges and treating background cells inside s as transparent
dst: aligned control bar marking the terminal row or column
transform: erase the control bars; keep original sprites and all copied sprite pixels
